set -eu
sudo sh -c '
exec 3>>/var/log/inventory/app.log
before_inode=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
printf "%s\n" continuity-before-rotation >&3
logrotate --force --state /tmp/inventory-logrotate-test.status /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app
after_inode=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
printf "%s\n" continuity-after-rotation >&3
exec 3>&-
printf "inode_before=%s inode_after=%s\n" "$before_inode" "$after_inode"
'

command:
set -eu
sudo sh -c '
i=2
while [ "$i" -le 8 ]; do
  printf "retention-cycle-%s\n" "$i" >> /var/log/inventory/app.log
  logrotate --force --state /tmp/inventory-logrotate-test.status /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app
  i=$((i + 1))
done
printf "%s\n" inventory-log-ready >> /var/log/inventory/app.log
'
printf '%s\n' '--- retained files ---'
sudo find /var/log/inventory -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'app.log.*.gz' -printf '%f\n' | sort -V
count=$(sudo find /var/log/inventory -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'app.log.*.gz' | wc -l)
printf 'compressed_rotation_count=%s\n' "$count"
[ "$count" -eq 7 ]
[ ! -e /var/log/inventory/app.log.8.gz ]
for f in /var/log/inventory/app.log.*.gz; do sudo gzip -t "$f"; done
